title: Coral and the Ghost
author: Oscar Coldharbour
blurb: Ada Galloway, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
